result.summary: The page appears visually complete and well-designed. No critical or major issues were found. There is one minor layout observation regarding the partially visible content at the bottom.

issues.description: The pizza image at the bottom of the screen is cut off by the navigation bar, which might make it look slightly broken or incomplete to the user.
issues.suggestion: Ensure that list items have sufficient bottom padding or margin so they are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar, or allow the user to scroll further to see the full item.
